title: PlayerMoodPlugin
description: Assigns random moods to players with unique effects that last 5 hours. New mood every 24 hours. Includes mood timer, mood list, and mood removal system!
body:
# 🎭 PlayerMoodPlugin

PlayerMoodPlugin is a unique Minecraft plugin that assigns random moods to players with special effects! Every player gets a different mood experience making the game more fun and unpredictable.

## ✨ Features

- 🎲 Random mood assigned via Rolling GUI on join
- ⚡ Each mood gives a unique potion effect for 24 hours
- 🔄 New mood every 24 hours automatically via Rolling GUI
- ⏰ Timer system to track when next mood comes
- 💾 Mood data saved even after server restart
- 🎛️ Admin panel to change any player's mood

## 🎭 Moods & Effects

| Mood | Effect |
|------|--------|
| ⚡ Swift | Speed Boost |
| 💪 Strong | Strength |
| 🦘 Jumpy | Jump Boost |
| 🌊 Floaty | Slow Falling |
| 👁️ Eagle | Night Vision |
| 🔥 Fired Up | Fire Resistance |
| 🍀 Lucky | Luck |
| ⛏️ Hasted | Haste |
| ✨ Glowing | Glowing |
| 🛡️ Shielded | Resistance |
| 🎯 Focused | Saturation |
| 💨 Breezy | Dolphins Grace |

## 📜 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| /mood | Check your current mood and timer |
| /mood list | See all available moods and effects |
| /mood admin | Open admin panel (OP only) |

## ⚙️ How It Works

1. Player joins the server
2. After 50 seconds a Rolling GUI opens
3. Mood rolls randomly and stops on one
4. Effect lasts for **24 hours**
5. After **24 hours** Rolling GUI opens again automatically
6. Admin can change any player's mood via **/mood admin**
